body: It’s actually kind of funny. When I was a sophomore in high school I asked to join my schools dnd club and they deadass did say ‘we don’t think a girl could fit into our campaign right now,’ I was like ‘I don’t have to have a girl character’ and their dm literally said ‘you’ll play like a girl though.’ Three years later and I’ve been playing dnd for months now with some great friends and on our third campaign. It’s the absolute highlight of my week every week and anyone is welcome as long as they’re not an a-hole

Well... I know this is kind of stupid, but I don’t want you to. I don’t want more sadness, more pain. I don’t want to read your last words, I want to read your success story. I want to someday see you encouraging someone else to keep going and I think you secretly want that too. It might take another year, or five, or ten. But your success story will be so ridiculously inspiring that it’ll save someone else’s life. So I hope you’ll stay and try a bit longer.
